description: Sequential focused Android defect-fix cycles for Aurum. Each task is diagnose -> narrow root-cause fix -> Android test/lint/build/install/physical-ADB-retest -> device-test version bump and audit/ledger update. Cycles are strictly sequential; no combined or speculative changes.

tasks.description: Eliminate the residual top black-bar spacing in the Tanishq browser refresh so the rendered gold-rate page sits directly below the fixed top chrome, matching the corrected BrowserRefreshScreen inset contract.
tasks.reason: User reports Tanishq opens better than before but still shows too much black-bar spacing at the top; a visual P1 defect in the Tanishq WebView host/insets/viewport.
tasks.requirements: Reproduce on a physical device first and measure the top gap (UI hierarchy / window dump). Diagnose the root cause across the tanishqRefreshing overlay Box in ui/AurumApp.kt (padding top=64dp/bottom=62dp + navigationBars inset) and ui/TanishqBrowserScreen.kt (visible header Row + LinearProgressIndicator stacked above the WebView Box, BrowserViewport.derive sizing, and any child offset). Compare against the already-corrected BrowserRefreshScreen to find the divergence causing the extra top band (double top inset, status-bar inset, or viewport offset). Fix ONLY the responsible inset/host/viewport layer for the Tanishq path. MUST preserve intentional Browser behavior: keep the single mounted WebView in its existing composition slot, do not move the slot, do not add a second WebView, re-run a factory, or reintroduce a keyed host; do not alter extraction, polling, parsing, or navigation-token lifecycle. Retest the same Tanishq refresh scenario on-device.
validationGates: install bumped 4.9.18/40918 debug APK with data retained via fixed adb path
physical ADB retest of the same Tanishq refresh; capture before/after screenshots proving the top gap is removed and Browser behavior is unchanged

tasks.description: Correct the bullion refresh progress so the user-facing total reflects all four bullion sources (Tanishq, Malabar, MMTC, Kalyan) instead of showing 3, while preserving each source's existing fetch transport.
tasks.reason: During bullion refresh the UI reports 3 instead of the expected 4; the progress total omits the browser-required Tanishq source that is refreshed in parallel via the rendered-page path.
tasks.requirements: Confirm the expected count definition: four default bullion sources exist in BullionRepository.defaultSources (Tanishq is TRANSPORT_BROWSER_REQUIRED; Malabar/MMTC/Kalyan are direct HTTP). Identify the failure boundary: BullionRepository.refresh(sourceId=null) filters out TRANSPORT_BROWSER_REQUIRED, so selected.size=3 drives BullionRefreshProgress.total, while Tanishq is refreshed separately through recordBrowserRates('tan', ...) via recordTanishqRate and is not counted. Correct ONLY the responsible progress/count layer so the combined bullion refresh reports total 4; the direct-HTTP loop continues iterating its own sources and Tanishq continues to use its required browser path. Do NOT change fetch transport, rate parsing, or persistence semantics. Add or adjust a regression unit test asserting the combined bullion refresh reports total 4. Retest a bullion refresh on a physical device.
validationGates: install bumped 4.9.19/40919 debug APK with data retained via fixed adb path
physical ADB retest of a bullion refresh; capture evidence showing the corrected total of 4
